title: Building an HTML5 game and I’m struggling with the visual assets to turn it from AI slop to good game design
author: Curious_Tower_5243
selftext:
Been making this card merging game with gemini (normal gemini not agent) the gameplay is good and enjoyable but the visuals are so bad and basic vanilla css and I've started learning coding this month. Does anyone know how to properly prompt an ai image generator to using an existing screenshot and ask it to improve the assets buttons, cards, text, etc without changing the placement  too much i tried myself and it keeps giving me bad results.

I want to make the assets look much more polished and like a real mobile game/html5 game. I would also appreciate it if  if any of you could upload the image to your favourite tool and upload this image and show me the fixed ui changes it made.

comments.author: Warsel77
comments.body: Take a screenshot, put it into ChatGPT and say something like: use this screenshot as a template. I am looking for.. bla bla.. style. Once you have it, slice it into individual images

replies.author: Curious_Tower_5243
replies.body: Thanks. Breaking it down would make it so much easier. I'll also try playing similar games get some inspiration

comments.author: Crazy_Memory
comments.body:
ChatGPT Codex + Aseprite.   
Have chat build aseprite files for all of your graphics, you can then touch them up.  
Also, go to the Lospec website, find a palete you like, and have it use that palete for UI and images.  
You can then alter the graphics in aseprite later if you decide to humanize your art.

comments.author: PigeonHeadArc
comments.body:
I have a few ways that I do it. I use claude to listen to what I want via voice and I include reference images, then I have it generate a prompt which I give to ChatGPT... then I copy and paste the result to Claude and further refine... I keep doing that till I land where I want....

Depending on what I'm doing I'll first generate the whole screen as a reference image, then break that into individual assets... or sometimes I'll take an asset I like, and use that as a reference to create the general screen. 

With this and an hour, you'll be golden.

replies.author: Curious_Tower_5243
replies.body: nice workflow too bad claude can't generate images it would be some much easier

replies.author: PigeonHeadArc
replies.body: Right, there are ways though, if you think outside the box. I just haven't cared to develop the workflow, but I'm sure taking something like paperclipAI where you have Claude be the CEO of your company and then you have ChatGPT as the image gen and Cursor and the coding agent, you could just talk to Claude and the rest gets done. I'm telling you there are ways you can make this process a one click almost, I just haven't cared to look into it.
